About

Designing with empathy, mostly. A camera, always.

Hi, I'm Srinidhi. I design the way I live — paying attention to the small stuff, because that's usually where the frustration hides. Somewhere between a confusing app screen and a person quietly giving up on it, there's a gap I like to sit in and figure out how to close.

Empathy isn't a slide in my process — it's just how my brain works. I notice when something feels off before I can explain why, and I've learned to trust that instinct enough to chase it into an answer.

My creative brain didn't start with Figma. It started with sketchbooks, library corners, and a camera I never quite know how to put down. I still learn more some days from a book, a walk with a good story in my ears, or — honestly — a well-timed reel, than from any course. I don't think that's cheating. I think that's just where curiosity lives now.

At the core of it: I make things so people feel a little less frustrated, a little more understood. That's the whole job, really.

📍 Based in Bangalore 🐶 Adopted by dogs that aren't mine 📚 Learns from books, reels, and everything in between
